description: This file defines the 'CommonTokenStream' class, which implements token streaming and filtering functionalities typically used in a parser or lexer framework. It handles token buffering, filtering by channel or type, and token lookahead operations.

classes.name: CommonTokenStream
classes.description: A class that manages a stream of tokens from a token source, allowing filtering and lookahead operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the token stream with a token source and optional channel.

methods.name: setTokenSource
methods.description: Resets the token source and clears the buffer.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Loads all tokens from the token source into the internal buffer.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Advances the current token pointer while skipping tokens not on the listening channel.

methods.name: skipOffTokenChannels
methods.description: Skips tokens not on the specified channel when moving forward.

methods.name: skipOffTokenChannelsReverse
methods.description: Skips tokens not on the specified channel when moving backward.

methods.name: setTokenTypeChannel
methods.description: Overrides the channel for specific token types.

methods.name: discardTokenType
methods.description: Marks tokens of a certain type to be discarded.

methods.name: discardOffChannelTokens
methods.description: Sets whether to discard tokens off the current channel.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Returns all tokens, filling the buffer if not already filled.

methods.name: getTokensBetween
methods.description: Returns tokens between specified indices.

methods.name: getTokensOfTypeInSet
methods.description: Returns tokens of specified types within a range.

methods.name: getTokensOfTypeInArray
methods.description: Returns tokens of specified types within a range.

methods.name: getTokensofType
methods.description: Returns tokens of a specific type within a range.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Returns the token at a specific lookahead distance.

methods.name: LB
methods.description: Returns the token at a specific lookbehind distance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the token at a specific index in the buffer.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Returns the type of token at a specific lookahead.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks the current position in the token stream for rewinding.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a marker (no-op).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of tokens currently buffered.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the current index in the token buffer.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds to a marked position or to the last marker.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the token pointer and marker position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the pointer to a specific index.

methods.name: getTokenSource
methods.description: Returns the token source.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the token source.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of all tokens.

methods.name: toStringBetween
methods.description: Returns a string of tokens between two indices.

methods.name: toStringBetweenTokens
methods.description: Returns a string of tokens between two token objects.
